opening.title: The first week of every SaaS,
opening.description: Auth, database, AI, translations and tests come wired. You start on your product, not on groundwork.

friction.title: The first weeks always disappear into the same work
friction.description: Sign-in flows, folder structure, test runners, Docker. None of it makes your product different, and all of it can go wrong. Here is what the template takes off your plate.

auth.name: Authentication
auth.starter: Better Auth and Clerk arrive pre-configured. Database sessions work in minutes.
auth.scratch: A day or two lost to endpoints, JWTs, cookie flags, middleware and user tables.

architecture.name: Architecture
architecture.starter: Self-contained modules behind one barrel import. New features can't tangle with old ones.
architecture.scratch: A folder layout improvised under deadline, refactored painfully six months in.

tests.name: Testing
tests.starter: Vitest and Playwright run out of the box, with smoke tests covering real routes.
tests.scratch: Hours of config files, runners, database seeding and CI before the first useful test.

ai.name: AI streaming
ai.starter: Server-sent events and a chat UI are already built, with five providers to choose from.
ai.scratch: Hand-rolling chunk parsing, retry logic and streaming state for every provider.

docker.name: Deployment
docker.starter: Multi-profile Docker Compose for the app, Postgres and ChromaDB, ready for any VPS.
docker.scratch: Writing Dockerfiles and compose files by hand, then debugging them in production.

fiveDays.description: A realistic path, not a countdown. Each day has a goal, a handful of tasks and the exact command to run. Tick them off as you go.

structure.statement: Every feature lives in its own module, behind one import.
